# The cmd/naut tests that run in their own CI job, "Go — naut rig tests"
# (ci.yml), beside the main Go job, which skips exactly these. They are the
# redundancy rig and pair tests (each starts real `naut run` processes and
# takes 5-30 s): about 313 s of cmd/naut's 580 s, which had reached the
# package's 600 s timeout. One name per line, exact. Rules, checked by
# naut-rig.test.sh: every name is a test in cmd/naut, and no other package
# has a test of the same name (the main job's -skip applies to every package).
# A test not listed here runs in the main job: nothing is ever left out.
